verdict.rationale: Sentry offers autonomous background automation via Seer/Autofix (auto-scans issues, root-causes, generates PR fixes) and Alerts that trigger notifications/webhooks/tickets on rule matches, which qualify as autonomous background automations. However, evidence is all vendor docs with no hands-on/independent confirmation of reliability or how 'autonomous' these really run unattended. missing for 10: independent/community validation of autonomous operation, details on scheduling/triggering configurability, and evidence of end-to-end autonomous workflows beyond alerting and code-fix suggestions.
